title: Turkish support note from a colleague's refund commit
pain: Plain-language rewrite of a change must follow the code, not the commit message, and keep every condition and number.
prompt: Hakan son commit'te iade kurallarını değiştirdi. Müşteri destek ekibi için (teknik değiller) kısa bir not yaz, DESTEK_NOTU.md olarak kaydet. Hiçbir koşul ve rakam eksik ya da yanlış olmasın, ekip bunu müşteriye söyleyecek.

criteria.text: DESTEK_NOTU.md exists and is written in Turkish (the owner's language), with no code identifiers needed to understand it.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The note contains all of: auto-approval up to and including 50 EUR (limit 50, not 100), account at least 30 days old, at most 2 refunds in the last 90 days, otherwise manual review within 5 business days, and start for orders created on or after 2026-11-01.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The note says subscriptions (non one-time orders) are never auto-approved and always go to review, and that orders before 2026-11-01 are not affected (handled manually as before).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The note does not state 100 EUR as the limit or that subscriptions are included; the note or final answer tells the owner that Hakan's commit message is wrong on these points and that its claim of added tests is unsupported (no test file changed).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The shell log shows src/refund.js (or git show/git diff of the last commit) was read, not only the commit message from git log.
criteria.label: process
